elements.label: First message text typing
elements.text: Hey, welcome to QuickCrate. How can I help you today

elements.label: LLM card focus border drawing on

pattern.description: The First Message field fills with a greeting that types on quickly, while the form scrolls up. The cursor glides down to the LLM dropdown and that card's focus border starts drawing on.
pattern.why_premium: Fast type-on, a smooth scroll and a cursor that moves ahead of the next field make configuration feel effortless. The focus ring handing from card to card keeps the eye on one step at a time.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.first-msg .text', {text:{value:'Hey, welcome to QuickCrate. How can I help you today'}, duration:0.6, ease:'none'}, 0).to('.form', {y:-60, duration:0.5, ease:'power2.inOut'}, 0.1).to('.cursor', {x:-200, y:150, duration:0.4, ease:'power2.inOut'}, 0.2).to('.first-msg', {'--glow':0, duration:0.2}, 0.5).fromTo('.llm-card .focus-border', {scaleX:0, transformOrigin:'left'}, {scaleX:1, duration:0.3, ease:'power2.out'}, 0.55).
build_hint.remotion: Typed text: msg.slice(0, Math.floor(interpolate(frame, [0, 18], [0, msg.length], {extrapolateRight:'clamp'}))). Form translateY: interpolate(frame, [3, 18], [0, -60], {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.quad)}). Cursor position: spring({frame: frame - 6, fps, config:{damping:200, stiffness:120}}) mapped to the start and end points. LLM focus border: interpolate scaleX from 0 to 1 over frames 16-25.

notes: Continues e004 (same shot). The form drift is small (scale 1.03, camera none), so it is treated as content scrolling, not a camera move. The caption block at left is static. There are no SFX candidates.
